justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/logger/ILogListener.java, NullLogListener.java, and StdLogListener.java. The package is self-contained: the only internal dependency is ILogListener, and StdLogListener only uses java.lang.System; there are no imports from other project packages. In contrast, 22 Java files elsewhere in the repo depend on this package (for example core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/core/IJITListener.java, core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/*, and tests such as core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestCompilationUtil.java). High fan-in with almost no fan-out indicates a stable package, so UD is not present.
